plan: Deep-copy the recipe, then scale every ingredient quantity and component yield with Fraction arithmetic.
Resolve excluded ingredients recursively using priority plus catalog-order selection, including replacement factors and additional ingredients.
Track substitution ancestry for cycles; accumulate every substitution and equipment failure before returning.
Apply wording and equipment changes deterministically, sort observable warnings/reasons/equipment, and preserve authored_text untouched.
mechanisms: Recursive ingredient-list discovery supports ingredients inside optional components.
Depth-first substitution resolution supports chained replacements and newly introduced ingredients.
Per-ingredient ancestry tuples detect substitution cycles without blocking independent diagnostics.
Catalog choices are sorted by numeric priority and original catalog position.
Equipment changes operate on copied recipe data; final availability is validated across equipment lists.
Instruction wording changes are accumulated in choice order and applied only to instruction strings.
